content:
The following section lists the maximum shard count for OpenSearch versions.
Engine Version
Limit
Notes
Elasticsearch 1.5 to 6.x
No default limit
Elasticsearch 7.x
1000
Default limit can be changed
via cluster. max_shard
s_per_node setting.
OpenSearch 1.x to 2.15
1000
Default limit can be changed
via cluster. max_shard
s_per_node setting.
OpenSearch 2.17 and above
1000 per every 16 GB of heap
to a max of 4000
The default limit can't be
changed.
